OVERVIEW OF BUSINESS GROUP
MODERN GOLD
Gold jewelry products composed of 96.5% pure gold are 
offered across a broad range of product categories, including 
necklaces, rings, bracelets, earrings, gold plates, and other 
related items.HIGH MARGIN PRODUCTS
▪Diamond jewelry products, including rings, earrings, 
bracelets, and pendants with necklaces.
▪Gold jewelry products containing 40.0% –99.99% pure gold, 
categorized into four product groups: (1) gold amulets, (2) 
belief -related products, (3) jewelry, and (4) gift items.GOLD FINANCING
The Gold Financing business, operating under the name 
“Thong Ma Ngern Pai,” generates revenue in the form of 
interest income.DIAMOND
DESIGN  
GOLDAurora’s revenue streams fall into three main categories: Modern Gold, High -Margin Products, and Gold financing (Thong Ma Ngern Pai).
In addition, the Company earns revenue through a range of services, membership fees, and other income streams.

AURORA YE2025 KEY HIGHLIGHTS 
AURA Display Performance 
as Targeted for Y2025
•Operating revenue totaled THB 39,914.7 million, 
representing an increase of THB 6,760.8 million, 
or 20.4% YoY, primarily driven by the continued 
expansion of the Modern Gold and Gold 
Financing businesses through systematic 
branch network expansion.
•Net profit amounted to THB 1,460.7 million,

performance target
•Interest income from the Gold Financing 
business totaled THB 960.1 million, representing 
an increase of THB 421.8 million, or 78.4% YoY.
•Accounts receivable (AR) balance amounted to 
THB 8,211.2 million, exceeding the Company’s 
target. This growth was supported by branch 
expansion in line with the Company’s strategic 
plan for this business.
The Company has continuously elevated its

Continuously pursuing growth

of both branch networks and 
business operations
In 2025, the Company expanded its branch network to 
a total of 629 branches, an increase of 141 branches, 
or 28.9%, compared with the previous year  The 
branch network comprised 229 Aurora branches, 56 
Seng Heng branches, 310 Thong Ma Ngern Pai 
branches, 20 Aurora Diamond branches, and 14 
Khong Kwan branches.

## Page 8

AURORA YE2025 AWARDS & RECOGNITIONS
The Company has continuously elevated its operational standards 
alongside the preparation of its sustainability reporting to ensure 
alignment with internationally recognized frameworks and best 
practices. In 2025, the Company was assigned an ESG Rating of “AA” 
by the Stock Exchange of Thailand. This rating reflects the Company’s 
steadfast commitment to conducting its business with responsibility 
across environmental, social, and governance (ESG) dimensions, 
while fostering long -term value creation and sustainable growth for 
all stakeholders.
The Company was awarded an “Excellent” rating, or 5 stars , under the 
Corporate Governance Report of Thai Listed Companies (CGR) 2025 , 
conducted by the Thai Institute of Directors Association, with the 
support of the Stock Exchange of Thailand and the Securities and 
Exchange Commission of Thailand. This recognition reflects the 
Company’s strong commitment to upholding high standards of 
corporate governance and best practices in line with established 
regulatory frameworks.
DOMESTIC AWARDS
•The Company was honored at the 13th Thailand Social Awards , 
underscoring its leadership in social media communications and 
digital marketing within the gold and jewelry industry. This 
recognition highlights the Company’s capability to effectively engage 
consumers and strengthen brand competitiveness. 
•The Company received the Volume Driver of the Year 2025 award 
from Pay Solutions, reflecting robust growth in transaction volumes 
and sales, as well as the effective management of payment channels 
to efficiently support business expansion.INTERNATIONAL AWARDS
•The Company was recognized in the Fortune Southeast Asia 500 list for 
2025 for the second consecutive year, affirming its stability, financial 
strength, and competitive capabilities within the ASEAN region.
•The Company received the prestigious World Branding Awards from the 
World Branding Forum, United Kingdom. This global recognition 
underscores the Company’s international -standard quality and service 
excellence, and reinforces Aurora’s strong leadership in the Thai gold 
retail market on the global stage for the eighth consecutive year.
•The Company was honored with the Top Jewelry & Watch Brands of the 
World award by Luxury Lifestyle Awards , United States. This award 
reflects the Company’s strength as a Thai gold and jewelry brand with 
the capability to elevate Thailand’s gold industry standards to the 
international level, while comprehensively serving the luxury lifestyle 
needs of high -end customers.

THBSUMMARY OF FACTORS AFFECTING GOLD PRICES 
IN FEBRUARY 2026
I. Geopolitical tensions between the United States 
and Iran:
were viewed by respondents as a key factor significantly supporting 
gold prices. In particular, risks associated with the Persian Gulf 
region and the Strait of Hormuz —one of the world’s most critical 
crude oil transportation routes —could have substantial implications 
for the global energy system. The potential for military confrontation 
and retaliatory actions between the two parties may lead to volatility 
in energy prices and broader financial markets. As a result, 
investors may increase their holdings of gold as a safe -haven asset 
to hedge against potential uncertainties and unforeseen events.
II. Trade tensions between the United States and 
Europe:
were also viewed by respondents as a factor supporting gold prices. 
The United States’ previous expressions of interest in acquiring or 
exerting control over Greenland —an area of strategic importance in 
terms of security and natural resources under the sovereignty of 
Denmark —have raised concerns regarding the stability of relations 
among allied nations. Such developments may affect investor 
confidence going forward, thereby reinforcing gold’s role as a 
structurally supported safe -haven asset.
III. The direction of the Thai Baht:
was viewed by respondents as largely dependent on the clarity and 
stability of the government following the election. If a government 
can be formed promptly and maintains strong stability, it may 
encourage foreign capital inflows and lead to an appreciation of the 
Baht. Conversely, delays in government formation or a weak 
administration could trigger market selling pressure, potentially 
weighing on the market and resulting in a depreciation of the Baht.
